_about: Browser solver benchmark (test D11): OR-Tools reference plans, with a 2 s guided local search per scenario (a time-limited reference, not a proven optimum), on random subsets of the boxwork (transect, relay) nodes, Balanced legs. Node 0 is the start, the last node the END (the walk ends at the rover); nodes of one group (one transect) are visited at most once. Generated by ariadne plan.
